summary: Macron home kit, launched 12 Aug 2026 for Diriyah's first Saudi Pro League season since promotion. No shirt sponsor found: the official launch photos and the club's own online-store product photos (front, back, sleeves, collar) show only the Macron logo, the club crest and the league sleeve badge. yelo and rassen were removed here: the 433fc season list they were cited from does not mention Diriyah. Home shorts and match-worn shirts not photo-checked, so the list is not marked complete.
